title: Hankweave Runtime Configuration
description: Schema for hankweave.json - runtime settings for the Hankweave server. See https://hankweave.dev/reference/configuration for documentation.

autostart.description: If true, run immediately on client connect

showCosts.description: If true, display cost data in the TUI

model.description: Model for every codon, replacing each codon's own model. Written like a codon's model: '<provider>/<model>', e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5'. Checked with its harness at startup.

anthropicBaseUrl.description: Custom Anthropic API base URL (for corporate proxies)

outputDirectory.description: Where to put results (relative to CWD)

executionBaseDir.description: Where to create temp execution environments

logParsingInterval.description: Interval for parsing Claude log files (milliseconds)

idleTimeout.description: Idle timeout for WebSocket and proxy servers in seconds (0-255). This is the maximum amount of time a connection is allowed to be idle before the server closes it. A connection is idling if there is no data sent or received.

shimIdleTimeout.description: Default shim idle timeout in seconds. Max time between agent events before the shim aborts. Per-codon and hank override settings take precedence.

dietOnFinalize.description: If true, compress a finished run's event journal at shutdown (large file bodies move to a per-run content-addressed store; restore with hankweave --restore-journal). Only runs after the run reached a terminal state (completed/failed).

journalDietThresholdBytes.description: Minimum file-body size (bytes) extracted to the content-addressed store by the journal diet. Fixed default of 4096; not intended as a tunable.

ignoreRigFailures.description: If true, ignore all rig setup failures (useful for resume workflows)

enablePersistence.description: Enable filesystem persistence for sentinel outputs

healthCheckGracePeriodMs.description: Grace period for sentinel health checks (milliseconds)

waitForAllHealthChecks.description: Wait for all health checks before loading sentinels

debug.description: Print payloads to console instead of sending

maxDollars.description: Global cost budget in USD. Effective global = min(runtime, hank).

maxTimeSeconds.description: Global wall-clock time limit in seconds. Effective = min(runtime, hank).

unpricedModels.description: What a dollar budget does with a model whose price no catalog source knows. 'estimate' (default) counts its tokens at a flagged ceiling estimate (the highest price among the model's siblings); 'refuse' fails validation instead.

noOnlineModelChecks.description: Stop Hankweave looking models up online (models.dev, LiteLLM prices, the model overlay, pi.dev, providers' model lists); the catalog then uses the model data bundled with this version plus its cache. Calls to the models themselves are unaffected. Env: HANKWEAVE_RUNTIME_NO_ONLINE_MODEL_CHECKS.

basedOn.description: A catalog model ('provider/model') to inherit every unspecified field from.

cost.description: Price per million tokens: what runs record for this model, over the harness's own price. Omit to keep the price of basedOn, or of the catalog's record for this id.

limit.description: Token limits. Required for a model the catalog does not know, unless basedOn supplies them.

models.description: Model records added to the model catalog for every run from this directory: new models, or the deployment's real prices and limits. Merged over hank.json `models`.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support
